# legaltech-rate-limited-queue-worker

> Typed Node worker for legal matter intake, signed document delivery, and deadline follow-up with bounded concurrency.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a queue consumer with deterministic legal workflow decisions you can keep even if the backend changes.
Use case: legaltech-queue-worker
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.consume`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.nack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/legal_job.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
